children: CDW said it has agreed to acquire Lovelytics, a data and AI services firm, in a transaction valued at about $525 million.

Lovelytics, a member of the Databricks Brickbuilder Partner Network, helps organizations modernize, govern and use data to improve performance and deploy AI at scale, CDW said. Lovelytics has experience across a number of sectors, including energy, manufacturing, retail, and financial services.
Lovelytics, which was founded in 2017, was the first consulting partner backed by Databricks Ventures, CDW added.
CDW also said the acquisition will expand its Services & Solutions portfolio in modern cloud, data and AI.
The deal is expected to close in the third quarter, and is not expected to have a material impact on CDW's financial results this year.
